assertions.assertion: Uses WebApplicationFactory<Program> with ConfigureTestServices to override IdentityServer registration
assertions.rationale: IdentityServerFactory extends `WebApplicationFactory<Program>` and overrides registration in `ConfigureTestServices`.

assertions.assertion: Sets options.KeyManagement.Enabled = false to avoid disk writes in CI
assertions.rationale: AddIdentityServer() is called with no options lambda; `KeyManagement.Enabled = false` is never set. The response only vaguely mentions ensuring key management doesn't write to disk without actually setting the option.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddDeveloperSigningCredential(persistKey: false) for a static test signing key
assertions.rationale: Uses `AddDeveloperSigningCredential()` without the `persistKey: false` argument required by this assertion.

assertions.assertion: Registers clients via AddInMemoryClients — no sub-documents needed for this core pattern
